research section, you know,
content you couldn't possibly
fathom. The popular novels and picture books are someplace else.

通俗小说和图画书在别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Why don't you rummage
through the bookshelves?
I'm sure you can find some
book there that can hold your
interest. Well, depending on
your actual attention span...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
您不妨在书架上翻翻看？
我相信您一定能找到一本能引起您兴趣的书。
当然，这取决于您的实际注意力...

[{0}]
By any chance...
Are you conducting
research about Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
顺便问一下...
您是在研究优配擂斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Why yes, that is
correct. But how did
you come to learn about
my current research project?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
是的，没错。
但您是怎么知道我当前的研究课题的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I managed to read
a thesis paper entitled,
''The Fall of Juperos,'' and
I just thought that the writing
style and your personality
seem to match for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我刚好读到一篇题为《优配擂斯的衰落》的论文，我只是觉得您的文风和您的性格似乎很匹配，不知为何。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Oh...! You read my
thesis? So what did
you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
哦...！
您读了我的论文？
那您觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So far, it's alright, but
quite frankly it's incomplete.
I mean, you don't have much in
in the way of conjecture, much
less any evidence to back up
any of your statements.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前来看还可以，但坦白说，它并不完整。
我的意思是，您在推测方面着墨不多，更不用说有任何证据来支持您的论点了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
....
Let me apologize for
being rude to you earlier.
As you know, my name is
Fayruz Khrhiyha. May I ask
what your name might be?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
....
请允许我为刚才的无礼向您道歉。
如您所知，我叫法伊鲁兹·克赫里哈。
请问您怎么称呼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm {1},
a brave adventurer in the
service of his royal majesty,
the wise and benevolent
King Tristram III.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是{1}，一位勇敢的冒险者，受雇于英明仁慈的特里斯特拉姆三世国王陛下。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, {0},
I understand that my thesis
still requires more evidence.
But I'd need some ancient
documents from Juperos
to complete my research...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯，{0}，我明白我的论文还需要更多的证据。
但我需要一些来自优配擂斯的古代文献来完成我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you happen to travel
through Juperos and find
any ancient documents, would
you bring them to me? Having
those would help my research
efforts immensely. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你有机会前往优配擂斯旅行，并找到任何古代文献，你能把它们带给我吗？
这将极大地帮助我的研究工作。
谢谢...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, it's you! Listen,
I just found a record of
an adventurer who explored
Juperos. There's mention
of a stone statue here that
just might be noteworthy...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
啊，是你！
听着，我刚刚发现了一份探险家探索优配擂斯的记录。
这里提到了一尊石像，可能很有价值...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you happen to find
yourself in Juperos,
would you find the stone
statue at the entrance of
its dungeon and read the
engraved message for me?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你有机会来到优配擂斯，你能去地牢入口找到那尊石像，并为我读取上面的铭文吗？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
According to my notes,
there's a spell that will
make its reader memorize
its message, even if they don't
know the language. So come
to me if you manage to read it.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
根据我的笔记，上面刻有一个咒语，能让阅读者记住铭文内容，即使他们不懂那种语言。
如果你能读出来，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you ever chance to
travel through Juperos,
would you let me know if you
find anything that might help
my research there? I'd be
very grateful for your help.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你有机会前往优配擂斯旅行，能否告诉我你是否发现了任何可能有助于我研究的物品？
我将不胜感激。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, you look
quite pleased.
May I ask what
happened to put that
expression on your face?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯，你看起来心情不错。
我可以问问是什么让你露出这样的表情吗？

scripts.text: I found something in Juperos.
scripts.translation: 我在优配擂斯发现了东西

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I went to Juperos like
you asked and found that
stone statue you were talking
about. Just like you said, there was an engraved message on it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我按您的要求去了优配擂斯，找到了您说的那尊石像。
正如您所说，上面确实刻有铭文。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Fascinating!
So is it really enchanted
so anyone can memorize it?
Wh-what does the message say?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
太棒了！
所以它真的被施了魔法，
任何人都能记住它吗？
那...铭文上写的是什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou recite the message
engraved on the stone
statue, unable to interpret
the sounds you're uttering,
but weirdly enough, you can
easily recall them from memory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你背诵石像上刻的铭文，虽然无法理解发出的声音，但奇怪的是，你能轻易地从记忆中回忆起它们。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see! Wait,
give me a moment to
properly translate this...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
啊，我明白了！
等等，请给我一点时间好好翻译一下...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It means, ''Do you wish to
see the end of the madness?
He is waiting where the three
columns were destroyed, where
two hundred illusions wander.''
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
意思是：“你想看到疯狂的终结吗？
他在那三根柱子被毁的地方等待，那里有二百个幻觉在游荡。”

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
''You will see him, the one
who was vain and extravagant,
with your own eyes at the place where the light passes through.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
“你将亲眼见到他，那个虚荣且奢靡之人，在光线穿过的地方。”

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, usually, descriptions
of the ''vain and extravagant
one'' refer to the mad scientist rumored to have lived in that
ancient era. But if this is true, I may have to rework my thesis...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
啊，通常，对“虚荣且奢靡之人”的描述指的是传闻中生活在那个古代时代的疯狂科学家。
但如果这是真的，我可能得重写我的论文了...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I have another favor to
ask of you. If you find any
object of historical significance in Juperos, would you bring it to
me? I'll reward you, of course.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
我还有一个请求。
如果你在优配擂斯找到任何具有历史意义的物品，能否带给我？
当然，我会给你报酬。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It would be most helpful
if you could manage to find
documents that existed from that era. Fortunately, back then,
they made all their records on material more durable than paper.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你能找到那个时代存在的文献，那就最好了。
幸运的是，当时他们记录所用的材料比纸张更耐用。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Nothing, huh?
My life is also fairly
uneventful, but somehow,
I'm don't think I'm content.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
没什么吗？
我的生活也相当平淡，但不知为何，我觉得自己并不满足。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh hello, {0}.
So what brings you to
the Juno Library today?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，你好，{0}。
今天是什么风把你吹到朱诺图书馆来了？

scripts.text: Nice weather today, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 今天天气不错，不是吗？

scripts.text: I found something in Juperos.
scripts.translation: 我在优配擂斯发现了东西

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, I wouldn't know.
It's late whenever I go
out, so I always happen to
miss the sunlight. I guess
I really miss nice weather
sometimes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯，我不太清楚。
我出门总是很晚，所以总是错过阳光。
我想我有时候真的很想念好天气，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, really?!
That's great news!
W-what did you find?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，真的吗？！
那是个好消息！
你...你发现了什么？

[Fayruz]

Would you mind if I keep
this Transparent Plate for
my research? In return, I'll
tell you some tales about
Juperos that I've learned.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，这一定是它！
你介意我把这块透明板留作研究用吗？
作为回报，我会告诉你一些我在优配擂斯学到的故事。

scripts.text: Please, be my guest.

This object is very valuable
to a researcher like me, but
I have no idea what use it
would be for an adventurer.
Well, you have your reasons...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯？
你是认真的吗？
这个物品对像我这样的研究员来说非常珍贵，但我不知道它对冒险者有什么用处。

here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦。
这里没有什么能对我研究有帮助的东西，但还是谢谢你。
如果你在优配擂斯发现其他东西，请回来给我看看，好吗？

scripts.text:

Ah, I see. Well, while
you're here, why don't you
read something? There are
many books that cover some
interesting topics, like the
Schwarzwald economy...
scripts.translation:

啊，我明白了。
既然你在这里，为什么不读点书呢？
有很多书涵盖了一些有趣的话题，比如秀发兹发德的经济...

scripts.text:

Oh, in any case, please
don't forget the favor I asked
of you. If you find anything
in Juperos that's historically
significant, I'd appreciate it
if you bring it right away.
scripts.translation:

哦，无论如何，请别忘了我拜托你的事。

scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，{0}！
你上次带给我的透明板对我的研究真的很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
This new data is adding
a lot more credibility to my
thesis. Oh, I'll be with you
in a moment, let me finish
translating this one last
passage really quickly...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
这些新数据为我的论文增加了更多的可信度。
哦，我马上就来，让我快速翻译完最后这一段...

scripts.text:

Oh, were you able to look
in Juperos for anything that
might help me in my research?
scripts.translation:

你好，{0}~
哦，你在优配擂斯找过可能对我研究有帮助的东西吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, take a look at this.

scripts.text: No, I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 不，抱歉

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, that's fine.
Besides, I don't really
have a deadline to complete
this research project. Still,
I just want you to know that
I really appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，没关系。
而且，我完成这个研究项目也没有真正的截止日期。
不过，我只是想让你知道，我非常感激你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
{0}...
I'm having great difficulty in
translating that Transparent
Plate you brought for me that
last time. I'm so frustrated...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
{0}...
你上次带给我的那块透明板，我翻译起来非常吃力。
我真是沮丧...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Wait a minute...
This here means...
Alright. Okay. Yes.
Yes! Of course, how
could I not see it before!
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
等一下...
这个意思是...
好的。是的。
是的！当然，我之前怎么没看出来！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I'll be with you
in just a second!
I think I just made
a real through...!
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
我马上就来！
我想我刚刚有了真正的突破...！

scripts.text:

Ah, I've been
expecting you, {0}.

were able to find something new that would help in my research...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
啊，我一直在等你，{0}。
所以你又去优配擂斯了吗？
我真的希望你能找到一些新的东西来帮助我的研究...

scripts.text: Actually, I did find this...

scripts.translation:

啊，我明白了。
既然你在这里，何不读点什么呢？
这里有很多书，涵盖了一些有趣的主题，比如现代冒险史。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh hello, {0}...

to the Juno Library this time?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，你好，{0}...
这次是什么风把你吹到朱诺图书馆来了？

scripts.text: I found another Transparent Plate.
scripts.translation: 我又找到了一块透明板

scripts.text: Just visiting, really.
scripts.translation: 只是随便逛逛

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Hmm, well, we've made as
much headway as we can
with the Transparent Plates
you've already given me, but
it can't hurt to have too much
evidence to back my theories.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯，好吧，关于你已经给我的那些透明板，我们已经取得了尽可能多的进展，但多收集一些证据来支持我的理论总是好的。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I really appreciate
your continuing efforts
to help me. Please, would
you take this as my way
saying ''Thanks?'' You've been
great, {0}...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
我非常感激你一直以来的帮助。
请收下这个，作为我表达谢意的方式吧？
你做得很棒，{0}...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Mmm...?
It doesn't look like
you brought another
Transparent Plate.
Are you sure that you
didn't misplace it?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯...？
看起来你并没有带来另一块透明板。
你确定没有弄丢它吗？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see. Well,
thanks to your help,
I've made a great deal
of progress on my thesis.
I really appreciate what you
have done for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
啊，我明白了。
多亏了你的帮助，我的论文取得了很大的进展。
我非常感激你为我所做的一切，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Thank you so much,
you don't know what
this means to me! Okay,
please relax and take a
seat. Close your eyes while
I tell you this ancient story.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
非常感谢你，你不知道这对我意味着什么！
好了，请放松，坐个位置。
在我给你讲这个古老故事的时候，请闭上眼睛。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel the protagonist's
glories and tragedies as if
you were actually there with
the hero on his journeys. The
tale eventually comes to an end
and you awaken from the trance,
gently brought back to reality.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你仿佛身临其境，与英雄一同踏上旅途，感受着主角的荣耀与悲剧。
故事终于接近尾声，你从恍惚中醒来，被温柔地带回了现实。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Everyone can relate
to these old, classic
stories. I hope this tale had
as meaning for you as it did
for me when I first heard it.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
每个人都能对这些古老的经典故事产生共鸣。
我希望这个故事对你来说，和我第一次听到它时一样有意义。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you can find me
another artifact from
Juperos, I'll share another
tale like that with you. Now
how does that sound? Okay
then, I'll see you, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你能再帮我找到一件来自优配擂斯的文物，我会再给你讲一个这样的故事。
怎么样？
那么，再见了，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, that's unexpected.
This Transparent Plate
seems to have been made
in a different era than the
one you gave me earlier.
How intriguing...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，这出乎意料。
这块透明板似乎制作于比你之前给我的那块更早的时代。
真是有趣...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
*Sigh* I really wish
that I could explore
Juperos on my own, but
I'm just not strong enough.
In a way, I'm quite jealous of you. But it can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
*叹气* 我真希望能亲自去探索优配擂斯，但我就是不够强壮。
在某种程度上，我有点嫉妒你。
但没办法...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
You know, that reminds
me of this great story of
a tragic hero that I'd like to
share with you. Let your
mind wander as I relate this ageless, yet bittersweet tale...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
你知道吗，这让我想起了一个关于悲剧英雄的精彩故事，我想与你分享。
让我带你进入这个永恒却苦乐参半的故事...让你的思绪随着我的叙述飘远吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFFayruz tells you a story
with a bright beginning, full
of hope that fills you with the
bliss of the heavens, but then
suddenly plummets you into all the despair and torment of hell.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF法伊鲁兹给你讲了一个故事，开头充满光明和希望，让你感受到天堂般的极乐，但随后突然将你抛入地狱般的绝望与折磨中。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story finally
reaches its ending
and you're surprised
to find yourself sitting
in the Juno Library.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF故事终于讲到了结尾，你惊讶地发现，自己正坐在朱诺图书馆里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I know it's a very
depressing story, but
I hope you enjoyed it.
I think you'd agree that
it contains a truth about
mankind that can't be ignored.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
我知道这是一个非常令人沮丧的故事，但我希望你喜欢。
我想你会同意，它包含了关于人类的一个不可忽略的真理。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
By now I'm sure you've
figured that these classic
tales are like condensed
experiences, refined and
immutable truths that we
can see in our own reality.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
到现在，我相信你已经明白了，这些经典故事就像是浓缩的经验，是我们能在自己的现实中看到的、经过提炼且不可改变的真理。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you find more of
these Transparent
Plates in Juperos, I'd be
very happy to share another
story with you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
如果你在优配擂斯找到了更多的透明板，我会很高兴再与你分享另一个故事，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, this one seems
to have been created
in a similar era as the
one you gave me earlier.
I'm not sure how much new
information this may provide...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，这个似乎与你之前给我的那个制作于相似的时代。
我不确定这能提供多少新信息...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, I'm sure this will
helpful in my research. I just
won't be as making progress
as quickly as I had projected.
Please, I'd like you to take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
不过，我相信这对我的研究会有帮助。
只是我的进展不会像我预期的那样快。
请收下这个，作为我感谢你的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now if you'll excuse
me, I need to go back
to compiling my research...
Thank you so much for
your help, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
现在，请原谅我，我需要回去整理我的研究了...非常感谢你的帮助，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦。
这里没有什么能对我研究有帮助的东西，但还是谢谢你。
如果你在优配擂斯发现其他东西，请回来给我看看，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Is this another
Transparent Plate?
Yes, it's quite different
than the last one you
brought over to me...
This is so exciting!
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
这是另一块透明板吗？
是的，它和你上次带来的那块很不一样...这太令人兴奋了！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. You must be thinking
that I'm a complete academia
addict. Well, my life might be
a little uneventful, but there
are other things I think about!
Like, well... It's weird but...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦。
你一定觉得我是个彻底的学术狂人。
嗯，我的生活可能有点平淡，但我也有其他思考的事情！
比如，嗯...这很奇怪，但是...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
You see, there's this
guy that I like. I'm not sure
where he might be now, but
his name is Nadim Amal. He's
my friend's brother who I first
met 10 years ago. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
你看，有个我喜欢的家伙。
我不确定他现在在哪里，但他叫纳迪姆·阿马尔。
他是我朋友的哥哥，我10年前第一次见到他。 ^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Just recently, I saw
him with his sister, my
friend from Morocc. It's
weird to think that I'd have
these feelings for him after
all this time, isn't it? Oh...!
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
最近，我看到他和他的姐姐，我在梦罗克的朋友在一起。
想到在这么长时间后我会有这种感觉，是不是很奇怪？
哦...！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I really should repay
you for this Transparent
Plate. Why don't I tell you
the scariest story that I know?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
我真的应该回报你这块透明板。
不如我告诉你我所知道的最恐怖的故事？

scripts.text:
^3355FFFayruz tells you a
creepy horror story that
makes you shiver with fear.
You've heard other ghost
stories, but you've never been
so deeply immersed in one before.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF法伊鲁兹给你讲了一个令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事，让你吓得发抖。
你听过其他鬼故事，但从未如此深刻地沉浸在一个故事中。^000000

scripts.text:
It is only when the
story ends and you return
to your senses that you notice that you're soaked in cold sweat.^000000
scripts.translation: 当故事结束，你回过神来，才注意到自己已经冷汗直流。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It may be a natural
response, but all people
fear the unknown in one way
or another. Scary stories are
appealing because we actually
like the strange and grotesque.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
这可能是一种自然的反应，但所有人都在某种程度上害怕未知。
恐怖故事之所以吸引人，是因为我们实际上喜欢怪异和丑陋的东西。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well... That's just my
opinion. Anyway, if you
find anything else in Juperos
that may help in my research,
please come back and show it
to me, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯...这只是我的观点。
总之，如果你在优配擂斯找到了任何可能对我的研究有帮助的东西，请回来给我看，好吗？
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, this one seems
to have been created
in a similar era as the
one you gave me earlier.
I'm not sure how much new
information this may provide...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦，这个似乎与你之前给我的那个制作于相似的时代。
我不确定这能提供多少新信息...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, I'm sure this will
helpful in my research. I just
won't be as making progress
as quickly as I had projected.
Please, I'd like you to take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
不过，我相信这对我的研究会有帮助。
只是我的进展不会像我预期的那样快。
请收下这个，作为我感谢你的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now if you'll excuse
me, I need to go back
to compiling my research...
Thank you so much for
your help, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
现在，请原谅我，我需要回去整理我的研究了...非常感谢你的帮助，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦。
这里没有什么能对我研究有帮助的东西，但还是谢谢你。
如果你在优配擂斯发现其他东西，请回来给我看看，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oooh...! This one is
much different than the
other ones you gave me
before. This should provide
a wealth of brand new insights
into the Juperos civilization!
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦...！
这个和你之前给我的其他碟仙恶灵很不一样。
这应该能提供大量关于优配擂斯文明的全新见解！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
All the Transparent
Plates you've given me
should contain more than
enough data for me to fully
complete my research thesis.
Once again, thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
你给我的所有透明板应该包含足够的数据，让我完全完成我的研究论文。
再次非常感谢你~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, that doesn't mean that
I will stop collecting data for
my research. Anyway, I have one last story to tell you, about
a man of pure heart chosen by the gods to serve and protect mankind.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
不过，这并不意味着我会停止为我的研究收集数据。
总之，我还有最后一个故事要告诉你，关于一个被神选中，为保护人类而服务的纯爱之心之人。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
For this purpose he was given
gaudy armor which contained
amazing powers, as well as a
book detailing the instructions
for its use. However, he promptly
lost these instructions...
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
为了这个目的，他被赋予了华丽的盔甲，其中包含神奇的力量，以及一本详细说明其使用方法的书籍。
然而，他很快就丢失了这些说明书...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story about the
greatest Juperosian hero
that Fayruz tells you is very
humorous at first, but then it
covers the entire spectrum
of emotion and humanity...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF法伊鲁兹为你讲述的这位优配擂斯最伟大的英雄的故事，起初非常幽默，随后却涵盖了人类情感与人性中所有的悲喜...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story ends and you
are left with a swelling
feeling of indefatigable
hope and inspiration...
You can make it if you try!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF故事结束了，你心中涌起一股不可动摇的希望与灵感...只要努力，就能做到！^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, that is the
last and the best story
that I have to share
with you. Perhaps next
time, I'll fill you in on my
research progress~
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
好了，这就是我要分享给你的最后一个也是最好的故事。
也许下次，我会告诉你我的研究进展~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Hmm...
This one seems to be created in a similar time
as the previous one.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
嗯...
这个似乎和之前那个
是在同一时期制作的。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Don't you worry.
This will help my research of course,
although I do not think this will
help me in advancing my research
with a great speed unlike this other one.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
别担心。
这当然会对我的研究有帮助，虽然我觉得它不像那个那样能让我以极快的速度推进研究。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Please take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
请收下这个，
作为我的一点心意。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now, excuse me. I need to go back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
那么，失陪了。
我需要回去继续研究了。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊鲁兹]
哦。
这里没有什么能对我研究有帮助的东西，但还是谢谢你。
如果你在优配擂斯发现其他东西，请回来给我看看，好吗？

scripts.text:
^8B6914Scholars are certain
that the Juperos civilization
used to be located above the
ground, but it is now buried
beneath the El Mes Plateau.
The reasons for the city's
ruin are still nebulous...^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914学者们确信，优配擂斯文明曾经位于地面之上，但现在被埋藏在尔迈斯高原之下。

scripts.text:
^8B6914Scholars are certain
that the Juperos civilization
used to be located above the
ground, but it is now buried
beneath the El Mes Plateau.
The reasons for the city's
ruin are still in debate...^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914学者们确信，优配擂斯文明曾经位于地面之上，但现在被埋藏在尔迈斯高原之下。
这座城市毁灭的原因仍有争议...^000000

scripts.text:
^8B6914There is much speculation
about the reasons for Jupero's
downfall, but any documentation
from that time period has been
difficult to find. As for now, any evidence we have regarding
Juperos is inconclusive.^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914关于优配擂斯衰落的原因有很多猜测，但那个时期的任何文献都很难找到。
就目前而言，我们拥有的关于优配擂斯的证据都不足以定论。^000000

scripts.text:
^8B6914In spite of this lack
of empirical or concrete
data on the civilization of
Juperos, our modern world
may be able to learn much
from that ancient city's ruins.
..................^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914尽管缺乏关于优配擂斯文明的实证或具体数据，但我们的现代世界或许可以从那座古城的废墟中学到很多。
..................^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmmm...
A whole chapter
dedicated to saying,
''We know absolutely
nothing about something.''
I should write a book~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
整整一章都在说：
“我们对某事一无所知。”
我也该写本书~

scripts.text:
^8B6914However, new findings
regarding the history
of Juperos have allowed
us to make a few conclusions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^8B6914然而，关于优配擂斯历史的新发现使我们能够得出一些结论。^000000

[{0}]
This is all just idle
conjecture! This paper
isn't developed enough
yet to be a real thesis...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这全都是无稽之谈！
这篇论文还不够成熟，不能算作真正的论文...

scripts.text:
^8B6914Juperos was built over
a thousand years ago in
an era of peace just after
a major war. Contrary to
popular belief, there isn't any
evidence proving that Juno may
have descended from Juperos.^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914优配擂斯建立于一千多年前的和平年代，那是在一场大战之后。
与普遍的看法相反，没有任何证据表明朱诺可能源自优配擂斯。^000000

scripts.text:
^8B6914In fact, there is a
strong possibility that
another war, between Juno
and Juperos, resulted in Juno's
independence from Juperos and
the destruction of any existing
documentation from that era.^000000
scripts.translation: ^8B6914事实上，极有可能朱诺与优配擂斯之间发生过另一场战争，这场战争导致了朱诺从优配擂斯独立，并摧毁了那个时代所有现存的文献。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... Of course!
It all makes sense now!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...当然！
现在一切都说得通了！

scripts.text:
^8B6914Juperos was built over
a thousand years ago in
an era of peace just after
a major war. There is now
direct evidence linking Juno
to Juperos proving that Juno
was but a part of Juperos.^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914优配擂斯建立于一千多年前的和平年代，那是在一场大战之后。
现在有直接证据将朱诺与优配擂斯联系起来，证明朱诺不过是优配擂斯的一部分。^000000

scripts.text:
^8B6914Just like Juno, Juperos
was a society that prided
itself on its advancement
in the sciences which played
a permeating role in civilized
life. Science was reponsible for Juperos's rise and downfall.
scripts.translation:
^8B6914就像朱诺一样，优配擂斯是一个以科学进步为荣的社会，
科学贯穿于文明生活的方方面面。
科学既是优配擂斯兴盛的原因，也是它衰落的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh. This writer keeps
talking about theories,
but the more I read, the
less clear I am on what
the theory actually is.
I don't think there is one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。
这位作者一直在谈论理论，但我读得越多，就越不清楚理论到底是什么。
我觉得根本没有理论...

scripts.text:
^8B6914What is most unsettling
is recent evidence, including
a first hand written account,
regarding the role of one of
Jupero's foremost scientists
in that city's rise and fall.
scripts.translation: ^8B6914最令人不安的是，最近的证据，包括一份第一手书面记录，揭示了优配擂斯最杰出的科学家之一在该城市的兴衰中所扮演的角色。

scripts.text:
^8B6914If these writings are
authentic, then what actually
happened was that a scientific
revolution occurred as a direct
result of one scientist's effort to manipulate the energies of the
artifact known as Ymir's heart.
scripts.translation: ^8B6914如果这些文字是真实的，那么实际上发生的是，由于一位科学家试图操纵被称为“依美乐的心脏”的神器能量，从而引发了一场科学革命。

scripts.text:
^8B6914This one man and Ymir's
Heart are credited with
the success and prosperity
of the Jupero's civilization.
However, there are various accounts prior to Jupero's fall
detailing his work with chimera...^000000
scripts.translation:
^8B6914正是这个人和依美乐的心脏造就了优配擂斯文明的成功与繁荣。
然而，在优配擂斯衰落之前，有许多关于他与凯美拉工作的记载...^000000

scripts.text:
^8B6914This scientist, supposedly
in his passion to benefit his
people by finding a scientific
method for immortality by using
chimera for testing, was driven
insane. He experimented on

^3300FFStrangely enough,
all four of the Crest
Pieces fit perfectly into
the slots and begin to
emit a strange light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3300FF*咔哒！*^000000
^3300FF奇怪的是，四块纹章碎片完美地嵌入了槽位，并开始散发出奇异的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: Pull out the Crest Pieces.
scripts.translation: 取出纹章碎片

scripts.text: Pull the lever.
scripts.translation: 拉动杠杆

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull out all
the Crest Pieces
that you inserted
into the slots.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将插入槽位的所有纹章碎片都取了出来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's strange,
but this lever has
already been pulled.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这很奇怪，但这个杠杆似乎已经被拉动过了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you pull the lever,
the Crest Piece slots are
suddenly covered, making
them irretrievable, and the
ground begins to shake
violently. This isn't normal!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一旦拉动杠杆，纹章碎片的槽位就会突然被覆盖，导致无法取出，地面也会开始剧烈震动。
这不对劲！^000000

scripts.text: Insert Crest Pieces.
scripts.translation: 放入纹章碎片

scripts.text:
^3355FFRight now, you don't
have enough Crest Pieces
to place into all four of these
slots. You'll need to find and^FFFFFF ^3355FF bring them all to make this work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF目前，你拥有的纹章碎片不足以填满这四个插槽。
你需要找到它们，^FFFFFF ^3355FF并将它们全部带来才能使其运作。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to find
some kind of object
that you can fit into
each of these four slots...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你需要找到某种可以放入这四个槽位的物品...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWho knows what
this lever may do?
You'll never know unless
you have the courage to try.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF谁知道这个杠杆会有什么作用？
除非你有勇气去尝试，否则永远无法知道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt seems like
someone else is
using this machine...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF似乎有其他人正在使用这台机器...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a Warp Portal
that will teleport you
to the previous floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一个传送之阵，可以将你传送到上一层。^000000

scripts.text: Use it.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:

Not now!
I can't leave yet!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在不行！
我还不能离开！
